title: Thunder D7 Gloss Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Optimized for spirited canyon carvers and urban commuters alike, the Studds Thunder D7 Gloss Black is tuned for riders carving apexes and commanding fast sweepers. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at 1457g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~87 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes with pressure-relief temple channels and contoured removable cheek pads.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Studds Thunder D7 Gloss Black: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Studds's Full Face lineup, the Thunder D7 Gloss Black brings Indian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Studds Thunder D7 Gloss Black represents Studds's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~87 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Studds Thunder D7 Gloss Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
